# A short essay with marked chapters

The essay reads top to bottom. Each chapter heading carries a ring in the margin, drawn once as the chapter
arrives and numbered in order.

::::section{title="Where the river bends" id="bend" mark="ring"}
The river turns west at the old mill, and the town grew on the inside of the curve where the water was slow.
Boats tied up there for a century before the bridge was built.
::::

::::section{title="What the bridge changed" id="bridge" mark="ring"}
Trade moved to the far bank within a decade. The mill closed, the quay silted up, and the inner curve became
a park that nobody planned.
::::

::::section{title="Notes" id="notes"}

- Sources are the parish records and two surveys.
- Dates are rounded to the decade.
  ::::
